_README: Illustrative model registry for Handoff: the exact envelope the reader (fleet._read_registry) accepts.
You normally do NOT hand-write this. Prefer:
python run/registry.py connect                    # find + register a local model server, re-check saved ones
python run/registry.py add http://localhost:8080  # qualify + register one endpoint
Those write the real registry (with qualification metadata) to the per-user path:
That path is per-USER and shared across every clone/project, so a returning user reuses it.
For a PROJECT-LOCAL registry instead, set FLEET_REGISTRY=/path/to/this-project/workers.json and copy this file there.
This _README key is ignored by the reader. 'version' must be 1; each key under 'workers' is one worker NAME.
Names defined in fleet.py (cluster, pairA, pairB, spark, vision) are reserved and would be ignored here.
Then select roles in fleet_settings.local.py, e.g. PRIMARY_WORKER = "my-worker" and SKEPTIC_WORKER = "my-skeptic".
A hand-written entry is not qualified: run `registry.py health <name>` (or `connect`) before dispatching to it.
reasoning_style: none | template_kwargs | budget_field. Leave defaults unless you have measured otherwise.
